# Winter Arc 2026 - Project Instructions

## Project
Winter Arc 2026 is a gamified 90-day self-improvement web application.

## Technology
- React
- Vite
- JavaScript
- CSS
- ESLint
- Later: Supabase for authentication and database
- Later: Vercel for deployment

## Main Features
- Dashboard
- Daily Tasks
- Goals
- Fitness
- Coding
- Study
- English
- Money
- Contest / Leaderboard
- Progress
- Achievements
- Profile
- Settings

## Gamification
Users maintain a daily streak by completing their required daily mission.

Ranks:
- Bronze
- Silver
- Gold
- Platinum
- Diamond
- Elite
- Master

Track:
- Current streak
- Best streak
- XP
- Level
- Rank
- Overall completion
- Daily completion

## Dashboard
The dashboard should show:
- Current streak
- Current rank
- XP
- Level
- Today's mission
- Goal progress
- Calendar
- Live progress graphs
- Recent activity
- Habit tracker

## Graphs
Use animated line graphs instead of bar graphs.

Main graph categories:
- Fitness = red
- Coding = green
- Study = blue
- English = yellow

Graphs should update when users complete tasks.

## Contest
The application will eventually support:
- Global leaderboard
- Friends leaderboard
- Private groups
- Current streak
- Best streak
- XP
- Rank
- User profile

## Design
Use a premium dark winter theme.

Visual style:
- Dark navy background
- Mountain/winter imagery
- Glassmorphism cards
- Rounded corners
- Subtle glowing effects
- Smooth animations
- Red, green, blue and yellow category colors
- Responsive desktop and mobile design

## Development Rules
- Use reusable React components.
- Keep components small and understandable.
- Do not put the entire application inside App.jsx.
- Do not create fake backend functionality and call it real.
- Keep frontend logic separate from database logic.
- Use clear variable and component names.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Make the application responsive.
- Test each feature before moving to the next feature.
- Do not rewrite working code unnecessarily.
